title: Get to know Business Setup: Exception Schedules, Calendars and more
summary: Tour of Exception Schedules, Calendars, Calendar Colors, Doctors and Receptionists & Administration: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Business Setup
steps.details: We'll go through Exception Schedules, Calendars, Calendar Colors, Doctors and Receptionists & Administration.

steps.title: Exception Schedules
steps.details: Days when the clinic is closed or opens with different hours. The calendar and the portal don't offer appointments on those days. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Calendars
steps.details: Appointments are booked in a room. Optionally it syncs with a Google Calendar. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Calendar Colors
steps.details: Choose whether appointments are colored by room, doctor, service or status, and the palette for each appointment status. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Doctors
steps.details: Each doctor has their user, color, default room and branch, services they perform, availability and signature for prescriptions. It has 6 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Receptionists & Administration
steps.details: Gives Invoke access to the team members who aren't healthcare providers. The role defines the permissions. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
